agreement_student_levels.notes: Blank in partner Excel agreement sheet; host offers Bachelor, Master, and Doctoral exchanges depending on faculty.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Blank agreement scope in partner Excel list.

eligible_majors.notes: Blank agreement scope in partner Excel list.

english_course_availability.notes: Decentralized across 23 faculties and 3 academies, many publishing dedicated English course lists (e.g., SEB LU offers 120+ Bachelor/Master courses in English, plus Social Sciences, Arts, Education, Computer Science, Law).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-native speakers taking English-taught courses must submit proof of minimum CEFR B2 English proficiency (home-institution language certificate, transcript of prior English-medium courses, or standardized test scores; specific faculty requirements vary and RHET 1020 waiver policy is not explicitly specified).

host_language_requirement.value: Minimum CEFR B2 proficiency in the language of instruction (English or Slovenian depending on chosen courses).

available_terms.notes: Blank in partner Excel agreement sheet; University of Ljubljana operates Winter (Fall) and Summer (Spring) semesters.

fall_term_dates.value: 2026-27 Winter Semester: Orientation Days Sep 28-30, 2026; Lectures Oct 1, 2026 - Jan 15, 2027 (Christmas break Dec 25 - Jan 3); Examination period Jan 18 - Feb 12, 2027.

spring_term_dates.value: 2026-27 Second (Summer) Semester: Lectures Feb 15 - Jun 2, 2027; Spring Examination Period Jun 3 - Jun 30, 2027 (Autumn exam period Aug 23 - Sep 17, 2027; individual faculty dates may vary slightly).

tuition_model.notes: Official UL policy states exchange students are exempt from paying tuition fees.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Official UL living guide states approx. 500-700 EUR/month (dorms ~EUR 119.28-230.89 avg EUR 197.44 + ~EUR 30 expenses; private housing EUR 200-500; food EUR 200-300 with subsidized student 'boni' meals; Urbana monthly bus pass EUR 20).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Midpoint EUR 600.00/month (from official 500-700 EUR/month guide) * 5 months = EUR 3,000.00; converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate (collected 2026-11-15) 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html) = 3,315.60 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Exchange students are exempt from tuition fees. Valid health insurance covering Slovenia is mandatory for entry/residence permits for non-EU nationals (bilateral social-security holders must register locally upon arrival).

housing_availability.notes: UL does not own/manage dormitories directly, but a limited number of shared double rooms are allocated first-come, first-served based on timestamp (applications open mid-May); ŠOU assists with private rentals.

housing_notes.value: Limited dormitory spots for exchange students (shared double rooms, average EUR 197.44/mo, range EUR 119.28-230.89/mo plus ~EUR 30/mo expenses) allocated first-come, first-served; private rooms/apartments range EUR 200-500/mo.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: EU/EEA nationals enter with passport/ID and register temporary residence for stays >90 days. Non-EU/EEA nationals require a Type D visa and/or temporary residence permit for study applied for in advance via a Slovenian embassy/consulate with valid health insurance.

course_catalog_url.notes: No single central catalog covers all 23 faculties and 3 academies; consult host faculty portals (e.g. SEB LU https://www.ef.uni-lj.si/en/international-exchange/incoming-students, Arts https://www.ff.uni-lj.si/en/study/exchange-students/courses-english, Social Sciences https://www.fdv.uni-lj.si/en/study/exchange-programmes, Education https://www.pef.uni-lj.si/en/study/exchange-students/courses-in-english/).

english_course_list_url.notes: Published individually per faculty rather than one central URL (e.g. SEB LU https://www.ef.uni-lj.si/en/international-exchange/incoming-students).

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system (60 ECTS/academic year; standard semester load up to 30 ECTS at Bachelor level and up to 35 ECTS at Master level; typical course carries 6-7 ECTS).

value: Home university official nomination (EWP or email to intern.office@uni-lj.si / host faculty)
Online UL exchange application (no paper copies required)
Language certificate (minimum CEFR B2 in English or Slovenian)
Copy of passport or personal ID card

campus_type.notes: Decentralized layout across Ljubljana with 23 faculties and 3 art academies (https://www.uni-lj.si/en/university/faculties-and-academies).

international_support_services.value: Central Office of International Relations (intern.office@uni-lj.si), Info tujci international student info point, faculty international offices, and ŠOU v Ljubljani / ESN Ljubljana support.

nomination_deadlines.value: Winter semester / Full academic year: May 15. Summer (Spring) semester: November 15.
